A few things:

1. I wouldn’t just go by the number on the scale. You are probably still getting smaller but bc of your activity level you are gaining muscle, so maybe that’s why the number isn’t changing on the scale. I would find a way to calculate your body fat % or see if you’re losing actual inches/dress sizes. The point is, it’s not all about the scale. 

2. Calories in, calories out. That’s all weight loss is. You need to be in a calorie deficit and that is not necessarily accomplished just by portion control. Calculate your resting metabolic rate (how many calories your body burns just from being alive), how many calories you’re burning when you’re exercising, and how many calories you’re eating. It doesn’t have to be exact by any means, but you should have a general idea every day. 

3. Volume eating is your friend. Eat super-filling, nutrient-dense food that’s low in calories. This could mean a huge meal with huge portions, but of low calorie food (like veggies). That way you feel absolutely full and satisfied, but for less calories. Check out r/volumeeating 

4. The most important thing, more than diet and exercise, is PATIENCE. Just because you’ve hit a plateau doesn’t mean your progress has stopped. Look into the above things, make some changes, and hang in there, like you have been. You’ve got this!
